sections.Overview:
Elemental Pinball is an addictive add-on game for the P 3 pinball platform. It’s free to download, and it’s playable on all P 3 playfield modules!
There is no need to “purchase” this free product. If you own a registered P 3 , a download link is available in your Multimorphic software download page . It’s also available for download/install in System Manager if your P 3 is connected to your WiFi network.
Category: Multimorphic Add-On Game Software
Battle the elements! Whether you’re trying to keep Earth (sand), Air (clouds), Water, or Fire (lava) from filling up the screen, shoot the open pop-up scoop quickly! The longer it takes, the faster the flow increases, and the less time you’ll have to progress. There are 4 different ways (gameplay modes) to enjoy the game:
- Endurance – Play for as long as you can, with the flow-rate per scoop increasing gradually. There’s no penalty for draining.
- Brutal – This is the most difficult mode. The flow-rate increases quickly, and draining a single ball ends the game!
- Solid – This is a level-based progressive mode. Shoot enough scoops to open the exit and progress to the next level.
- Gems – Leveraging the lower playfield ball tracking, this mode is similar to Solid but adds gem collection as a way to push for higher scores. Exit scoops open after a certain amount of time.
Elemental Pinball is free and works with all P 3 playfield modules, making it playable on any P 3 ! Download and enjoy it today!
